scope: Nine unchanged native compatible Newton/pseudo-time saddle systems, 54 linear solves; standard LSC pressure approximation and full/upper block factorization comparison. No production solver/default change and no complete nonlinear flow run.

hypotheses.lsc: L=B D^-1 G with D=diag(Picard velocity block). Approximate negative pressure Schur inverse by -L^-1 B D^-1 A D^-1 G L^-1, using the full true Newton velocity A. Same Picard ILU0 for velocity.
hypotheses.factorization: Upper block uses r_p directly; full block first computes r_p-B Ahat^-1 r_u, then uses the same pressure inverse and final velocity solve.
pressureInverseControls: IC0 of exactly the same L for schur and lsc
Native dense LU of exactly the same L for a small reference; not the exact saddle Schur complement

denseReferenceLimit.reason: Bound a cubic diagnostic reference; 256^2 doubles is 0.5 MiB before copies. This is not a mesh quality or physical tolerance.

algebraControls: For diagonal velocity A, dense-L LSC equals the exact pressure inverse, including sign.
For the same known coupled matrix, full dense-L/diagonal-A factorization reproduces the complete right-hand side.
hypotheses.algebraErrorAllowance: 256 * machine epsilon * (1 + reference vector norm), only for the tiny known coefficient identity; no CFD acceptance gate.

globalControls.targetType: True original unpreconditioned b-Kx, same strict Krylov-target implementation as 7d13998

retainedCoefficientComparison.meaning: Unweighted differences of retained face P1 velocity coefficients and cell pressure means in existing U=L=1 native units; not recovered cell-field RMS, spatial error or nonlinear convergence.
retainedCoefficientComparison.largestDifferenceCase: sheared4-stalled, a matrix about the last accepted but nonconverged direct-Newton state. Similar true residuals do not imply equally tiny coefficient differences.

decisions: Do not adopt this IC0-LSC implementation as default: all nine tested IC0 cases used more outer products and additional pressure/velocity-block work.
Even dense internal pressure solves do not give a general LSC cost advantage; reducing the pressure inverse error alone does not rescue this formula on these controls.

Do not adopt the full-block variant as default: first-system gains are small/inconsistent, the final sheared matrix worsens 115 to 148 outer products and each application requires two velocity inverse applications.
Keep the current production Schur/GMRES baseline. Continue seeking a scalable coupled approximation and evaluate candidate methods on the preserved original cloud matrices before a default change.

timingScope.exclusions: Reported totalSeconds excludes self-check, result writing, matrix assembly and compilation. commands.json retains complete child-process times including outputs. Runs were not exclusive-machine measurements; no full CFD speedup claim.
timingScope.workAccounting: Record outer matrix products, LSC internal full velocity-block products and pressure solves separately. Full variant reports both velocity inverse applications; earlier upper/LSC records imply one velocity inverse per preconditioner application from their fixed implementation.
timingScope.counterInterpretation: outerMatrixProducts counts the GMRES operator applications. Each completed restart also evaluates the original Kx once for true residual checking. The added trueResidualCheckMatrixProducts and totalOriginalMatrixProductsIncludingChecks are derived from this fixed source. velocityInverseApplications is measured for full mode and derived one per preconditioner application for the earlier upper/LSC records.

sourceLineage.note: Full factorization added as a separate mode after the first LSC comparison; final baseline cylinder solution matches the original baseline byte-for-byte.

validation.reason: Production source unchanged; actual research runs and algebra controls exercise the new independent entry point.

limits: Only 16/64/256-cell controlled meshes and a 64-cell real cylinder cut-cell input; original cloud 4,716/17,260-cell systems were not run locally.
All states here are linear candidates; no new nonlinear convergence, physical branch selection or curved-wall pressure qualification.
No product API/CLI integration of either attempted method; no frontend/App or other-platform validation.
A poor small-control result does not prove every LSC/discretization/scale combination is poor. The rejected default candidate is this specific implementation.

rawArchive.retention: Preserve this unique compressed raw archive until a durable cloud copy is confirmed; small source and summary are versioned separately.

temporaryCleanup.scope: Only the raw study directory and six explicitly listed helper files, after exact archive member/hash readback and no-open-files / no-active-study-process checks. Input, failed-state and all numerical result bytes remain in the archive.
